name: takeabite
description: In-depth YouTube summaries: timestamped sections, key takeaways and answers straight from the video.

interface.longDescription:
Bite isn't a three-line TL;DR. It turns long YouTube videos into structured, in-depth summaries you can actually learn from: a quick overview, then timestamped sections that walk through the video's argument in order, refresher cards for the key ideas, and actionable insights grouped by theme. A two-hour podcast comes back as a proper read, not a paragraph.

Connect your Bite account and paste any YouTube link into the conversation. Bite reads the full transcript, writes the summary in 30 to 90 seconds and saves it to your library, where it's also available in the Bite iOS and Android apps.

Ask follow-up questions and Bite answers from the full transcript, not just the summary, so you get the exact figure, quote or step the speaker mentioned. Search your library by title or channel and pull any earlier summary back into the chat.

See what's trending on Bite, or what the channels you follow have uploaded this week, and summarize the ones worth your time.
capabilities: Summarize a YouTube video into timestamped sections, key takeaways and actionable insights
Answer questions about a summarized video from its full transcript
Search and read the summaries in your Bite library
List trending videos and new uploads from the channels you follow
defaultPrompt: Summarize this YouTube video and give me the key takeaways: <link>
What exactly did the speaker recommend in my last Bite summary?
Any new videos from the channels I follow on Bite this week?

positive.expected_behavior: Returns the full summary with a quick overview, timestamped sections, key takeaways and actionable insights, plus a Read on Bite link. Credits are deducted at 0.6 per minute of video.
Lists the account's summaries with video title, channel and date. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Ask a transcript-grounded question about a saved summary
positive.prompt: In my Rick Rubin summary, what did he say about taste?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Rick Rubin summary and answers from the video's transcript with specifics the speaker said. 1 credit is spent.

positive.prompt: How many Bite credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the credit balance and roughly how many hours of video it covers. No credits are spent.

positive.prompt: Any new videos from the channels I follow on Bite this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists new long-form uploads from the account's followed channels in the last 7 days, with length and summarize cost. No credits are spent.

negative.prompt: Ask my Rick Rubin summary what the weather is in Paris today

publication.release_notes: First release: summarize YouTube videos, ask questions from the transcript, browse your Bite library, trending picks, new uploads from followed channels and credit balance.
